mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) can potentiate sympathomimetic effects and systemic absorption of timolol, increasing risk of hypertensive crisis and cardiac dysrhythmias; beta-blockers may mask hypoglycemic symptoms and interact with MAOI metabolism.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest timolol dose with careful monitoring of blood pressure, heart rate, and cardiac rhythm; educate patient on signs of hypertensive crisis.
